unsupported: The business was established in 2018 by an avid angler who grew up bluegill fishing with his father and younger brother.
The company functions as a full-service marine electronics retailer.
It sells fish-finding and navigation units, handles professional installation, and then provides personalized training on how to operate the equipment.
The primary clientele are recreational anglers and boaters in the Central Kentucky region.
Customers range from beginners needing basic orientation to experienced fishermen looking to maximize the capabilities of advanced sonar and GPS systems.
